GGEL.title: Encounter Lens
GGEL.subtitle: Crónicas Bárdicas
GGEL.ui.partyHint: Pick the characters who will be at the table.
GGEL.ui.encounterHint: Load monsters from the canvas or the combat tracker.
GGEL.ui.emptyReport: Pick a party and an encounter, then read the omens.
GGEL.warn.noParty: Select at least one character first.
GGEL.warn.noEncounter: Load at least one monster first.
GGEL.warn.noTokens: No tokens selected on the canvas.
GGEL.warn.noNpcTokens: None of the selected tokens are NPCs.
GGEL.warn.noCombat: There is no active combat in this scene.
GGEL.warn.noCombatNpcs: The combat tracker has no NPCs.
GGEL.warn.gmOnly: Only the GM can use Encounter Lens.
GGEL.verdict.threat: This encounter has teeth. Read the red flags.
GGEL.verdict.clear: No red flags: the matchup looks even.
GGEL.note.dmgNeutralized.head: {monster}: {pcs} cannot hurt it
GGEL.note.dmgNeutralized.body: Immune to {immune}. Those characters need another damage source.
GGEL.note.dmgResistedHalf.head: {monster} resists half the party's damage
GGEL.note.dmgResistedSome.head: {monster} resists {pcs}
GGEL.note.dmgResistedSome.body: Resists {resist}. Manageable if the rest carry the damage.
GGEL.note.dmgVulnerable.head: {pcs} hit {monster}'s vulnerability
GGEL.note.dmgVulnerable.body: Vulnerable to {vulnerable}: lean on that damage type.
GGEL.note.saveMulti.head: {monster}: {count} effects call for {ability} (DC {dc})
GGEL.note.saveMulti.body: Likely to fail: {failing} (party average {avg}). E.g. {examples}. Nobody with solid {ability} to anchor.
GGEL.note.saveSingle.head: {effect} ({monster}): {ability} DC {dc}
GGEL.note.saveSingle.body: Likely to fail: {failing} (party average {avg}). Nobody with solid {ability} to anchor.
GGEL.note.reachNone.head: Nobody can reach {monsters}
GGEL.note.reachNone.body: The whole party is melee-only. They get kited with impunity.
GGEL.note.reachPartial.head: {melee} will be left without a target
GGEL.note.reachPartial.body: Only {ranged} can reach {monsters}. Plan how to bring them down.
GGEL.note.economy.head: Outnumbered {enemies} to {party} in actions
GGEL.note.economy.body: {ratio}× enemies per character. Without crowd control or a chokepoint, they eat damage every round.
GGEL.note.defensive.head: {pc} (AC {ac}, {hp} HP) is the weak link
GGEL.note.defensive.body: {monster}'s {attack} hits at +{toHit} (~{hitPct}) for ~{dmg}: drops them in {hits} hit(s). Watch the focus fire.
GGEL.note.estimated.head: Estimated values for {pcs}
GGEL.note.estimated.body: AC or HP had to be derived from source data. Active effects such as Mage Armor are not counted.
GGEL.note.baseline.head: Context: total CR {cr} vs total level {levels}
GGEL.note.baseline.body: A raw tonnage reference, not a verdict. The briefing above is what matters.
GGEL.ui.planHint: A suggested script for running the monsters with intent.
GGEL.ui.emptyPlan: Read the omens to generate the plan.
GGEL.note.dmgPartialImmune.head: {monster} is immune to part of {pcs} damage
GGEL.note.dmgPartialImmune.body: Immune to {blocked}. That avenue is dead: they will have to switch resources mid-fight.
GGEL.note.softSpot.head: {ability} is the party soft spot
GGEL.note.softSpot.body: {monsters} different monsters punish it with {count} effects, and the party fails {avg} on average. Not a coincidence — that is the hole.
GGEL.plan.attack.head: {monster} attacks {target} with {move}
GGEL.plan.attack.body: {hitPct} to hit, ~{dmg} expected damage. {target} drops in {hits} hit(s).
GGEL.plan.saveDamage.head: {monster} uses {move} — {ability} DC {dc}
GGEL.plan.saveControl.head: {monster} uses {move} on {target}
GGEL.plan.saveControl.body: {ability} DC {dc}: {target} fails {failPct}. Pure control — taking them out of the round beats raw damage.
GGEL.plan.auto.head: {monster} uses {move}
GGEL.plan.auto.body: ~{dmg} automatic damage, no roll to save them.
GGEL.plan.legendary.head: Legendary action: {move}
GGEL.plan.legendary.body: {monster} uses it at the end of another turn. Breaks the party rhythm.
GGEL.plan.lair.head: Lair action: {move}
GGEL.plan.lair.body: On initiative 20 for {monster}. Only if they fight in its lair.
GGEL.plan.cont.reserve.head: Save {move} for when {monster} is bloodied
GGEL.plan.cont.reserve.body: It is the limited resource. Spending it early wastes the second-act punch.
GGEL.plan.cont.flyRanged.head: If {monster} takes damage, let it climb
GGEL.plan.cont.flyRanged.body: The party has reach, so it is not a full escape — but it forces them to spend their best actions at range.
GGEL.plan.cont.flyNoRanged.head: If {monster} takes damage, let it climb
GGEL.plan.cont.flyNoRanged.body: Nobody in the party can reach altitude: from the air it punishes them for free. Use with judgement or the fight turns unfair.
GGEL.plan.cont.pcDown.head: If {first} drops, focus shifts to {next}
GGEL.plan.cont.pcDown.body: The next most fragile. A monster with instinct does not spread damage: it finishes what it started.
GGEL.plan.cont.softSpot.head: Keep leaning on {ability} effects
GGEL.plan.cont.softSpot.body: The party fails {avg} on average. If the fight stalls, that is the lever.
GGEL.plan.attackSave.head: {monster} attacks {target} with {move}
GGEL.plan.attackSave.body: {hitPct} to hit, ~{dmg} damage; drops in {hits} hit(s). It also calls for {ability} DC {dc}: {target} fails {failPct}.
GGEL.plan.multiattack.head: {monster} unloads its routine on {target}
GGEL.plan.multiattack.body: {move} — {routine}. ~{dmg} expected damage for the round; {target} drops in {hits} round(s) of this.
GGEL.ui.capped: Showing {shown} of {total} matches. Narrow the search or filter by folder.
GGEL.warn.noName: Give the encounter a name before saving it.
GGEL.warn.missingActors: {n} actor(s) from the saved encounter no longer exist and were skipped.
GGEL.plan.multiattackRaw.head: {monster} multiattacks {target}
GGEL.plan.multiattackRaw.body: {move}, but the exact routine could not be read. Build the round from: {options}. You can repeat one attack or mix them.
GGEL.note.multiattackRaw.head: {monster} has {feature}, but the routine could not be read
GGEL.note.multiattackRaw.body: The real round hits harder than shown above. Its attacks are: {options}. Pick the combination its stat block calls for.
